Name: HxW Tea Conservatory for CP and PIF
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[size=4]This mod makes use of PIF to create a bright and airy conservatory with a tea-theme, inspired by Caroline's sun room and chill cibes. It can be accessedd via any decorative door in game. Just place a door on a wall, choose "Tea Conservatory" and presto change-o you have your new space to decorate and even grow crops/tea saplings in!

This room was originally made to be used with our new Tea Shop Style Shed as a fun add on, but Hime also created an amazing building version if you'd prefer to use it on its own![/size][b]


[b][size=6][quote][center]IMPORTANT UPDATE INFORMATION FOR VERSION 1.2[/center][/quote][/size][/b][/b][font=Georgia][size=3][font=Georgia][size=4][font=Georgia][size=3][center]
The code had to be overhauled for our buildings because to be honest, we ended up with so many that it was getting quite messy in there and hard
to find bugs and things. Because of this, the internal IDs of nearly all of the buildings have changed and therefore the game will [i]not[/i] recognize your buildings from the previous version of the mod.  For a[b] new save[/b], or a save where you have not built any of our buildings yet, this is fine and you can just install and enjoy! [/center][/size][/font]
[/size][color=#f6b26b][size=3][b]YOU MUST FOLLOW THESE DIRECTIONS BEFORE UPDATING THE BUILDINGS MOD IF YOU HAVE AN EXISTING SAVE[/b][/size][/color][/font][color=#f6b26b]:[/color][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=3]

[list=1]
[*]Load your existing save and empty out any existing HXW Buildings you have of all contents. Store it all wherever you want just NOT IN THE BUILDING.
[*]Visit Robin and demolish these buildings. Sorry but they have to be gone before you update the mod.
[*]Save the game and exit. 
[*]Delete the old version of the mod and cleanly install the new version. 
[*]If you wish to give yourself enough $ to re-purchase the buildings you had to demolish, use a mod like CJB Cheats that will allow you to do so.
[*]Run the game and check the configurations in Generic Mod Config Menu to make sure it looks correct.
[*]Give yourself the money you need and visit Robin and rebuild the buildings you had to demolish.
[/list][/size][/font][size=3][font=Georgia][size=3][font=Georgia][size=3][font=Georgia][color=#f6b26b][size=3][i]
We know this is a bit of a headache now but trust us, this was a band-aid that had to come off so we appreciate your understanding![/i][/size][/color][/font][/size][/font][/size][/font]
[/size][b][size=3]
[b][img]https://i.imgur.com/cNjfrI3.png[/img][/b]

[/size][/b][size=3][size=4]Credit first and foremost to Hime, my wonderful friend whose art never ceases to inspire me to more modding madness. You bring so much fun into my life and I love you so much hehe <3[/size][size=4]

Thanks to my wonderful friends on discord who support me and my shenanigans - I love you all so much <3[/size]
[size=4] [img]https://i.imgur.com/WrSO1e5.png[/img]

[/size][b][size=5]Enjoy what Hime does? Support her on [url=https://www.patreon.com/Himetarts]Patreon[/url]﻿ and follow her on [url=https://twitter.com/himetarts]Twitter[/url] for previews!

Buy Wildflour a [url=https://ko-fi.com/wildflourmods]Kofi[/url]﻿ OR CHECK HER OUT NOW ON [url=https://www.twitch.tv/wildflourmods]TWITCH[/url]﻿! [/b][/size][i][size=4] [img]https://i.imgur.com/T0uVb7A.png[/img]

[/size][/i][size=3]This mod is for SDV 1.6 - it is not compatible with older versions of the game. [b]It is untested for mobile or multiplayer.[/b] though if all the same mods are installed, multiplayer should be fine. I cannot troubleshoot mobile; multiplayer your best bet is to try the SDV
modded game support discord channel as it is often too hard for me to diagnose the issue across multiplayer saves. [/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/DhwwHA2.png[/img]
[size=4]
[b]This mod is currently in English, with more on the way we hope ![/b]

If you would like to translate this mod into another language, please reach out to me or Hime. Please remember [u]translators are just volunteers[/u] and though I am eternally grateful for their work, they are not [u]required[/u] to do so and so there can be delays with updating translation files![/size]
